title: Bentar Lagi Jalan
mood: exasperated and bouncing, laughing through the wait
subject: a new employee stuck in an empty angkot at the terminal while the driver waits for it to fill up and keeps saying it is leaving any minute
caption: Indonesian ska punk in the 90s Jakarta style. Offbeat electric guitar skanks, muted upstroke chops on every 'and'; a combo organ bubbling on the offbeats; a horn section of trumpet, trombone and tenor sax playing short unison riffs that answer each vocal line; a bouncy electric bass walking between chord tones; drums playing a fast ska beat with eighth-note hi-hats and the snare on two and four, switching into punk double-time for the choruses. Bright and live, the horns and the lead vocal forward, the drums roomy. Shouted-sung male lead, playful and a little hoarse, with a crowd of male voices chanting the answer lines. 172 BPM, B-flat major. Exasperated and bouncing, laughing through the wait. No reggae one-drop, no slow dub bass, no pop-rock ballad chorus, no autotune, no synth leads.
lyrics:
[Intro - horn riff over the guitar skank]

[Verse 1]
Hari pertama kerja, aku naik angkot biru
Jam tujuh kurang, cuma aku sama sopir
Mesin nyala, radio muter dangdut
Tapi rodanya nggak gerak dari tadi

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku tanya, "Bang, kapan berangkat?"
Dia ngelap kaca, terus jawab santai

[Chorus - the crowd chants the answers]
"Bentar lagi jalan!" (Bentar lagi!)
Udah setengah jam, belum jalan
"Bentar lagi jalan!" (Bentar lagi!)
Aku masuk kantor jam delapan, Bang!

[Verse 2]
Naik ibu-ibu bawa dua karung bawang
Naik anak SMA, naik bapak bawa ayam
Bangku udah penuh, ayamnya di pangkuanku
Sopirnya masih teriak, "Masih muat, masih muat!"

[Bridge - horns go double-time, the crowd answers]
"Geser dikit, Neng!" (Udah mentok, Bang!)
"Geser dikit, Pak!" (Ayamnya protes!)

[Chorus - the crowd chants the answers]
"Bentar lagi jalan!" (Akhirnya jalan!)
Dua ratus meter, "Kiri, Bang!"
Kantor baruku ternyata dekat banget
Besok aku jalan... kaki aja!

[Outro - horns and the crowd chant, then a hard stop]
Bentar lagi jalan... kaki!

[Song ends abruptly]
